savedQueries.name: revenue_total
savedQueries.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'fulfilled'

savedQueries.name: revenue_by_user
savedQueries.sql: SELECT u.name AS user_name, SUM(o.amount) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.status = 'fulfilled' GROUP BY u.name ORDER BY revenue DESC

savedQueries.name: orders_by_plan
savedQueries.sql: SELECT o.id, u.name AS user_name, o.status, o.amount FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE u.plan = :plan ORDER BY o.placed_at DESC

savedQueries.name: plans
savedQueries.sql: SELECT DISTINCT plan FROM users ORDER BY plan
